name: Laser orbit determination
description: Routes ILRS normal points or RA/Dec angles ($TDM), station coordinates ($GST) and the Earth orientation through analysis/estimation fit_batch and propagator/ffm invoke until the estimator converges, and emits the fit as one Cartesian $OCM with FIT_STATISTICS and PVN. Stateless: each step call either asks for a propagation or an estimator round, or finishes. The estimator solves and the FFM propagates; the node rotates the stations to GCRF with foundation/frames' IAU 2006/2000A chain. Refusals by name: no-stations, arc-too-short:<hours>, no-convergence:<iterations>.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each call is one bounded routing step over its inputs; the estimator and the propagator are separate modules the host runs.

methods.displayName: One routing step of the laser orbit determination

acceptedTypeSets.description: The normal points: one $TDM per pass from data-source/ilrs-crd-source read_crd (LASER_RANGE in metres, UTC, TIMETAG_REF TRANSMIT or RECEIVE, OBSERVER_ID the station occupancy designator, meteorology rows).

inputPorts.description: The normal points: one $TDM per pass from data-source/ilrs-crd-source read_crd (LASER_RANGE in metres, UTC, TIMETAG_REF TRANSMIT or RECEIVE, OBSERVER_ID the station occupancy designator, meteorology rows). Or RA/Dec tracks (ANGLE_TYPE RADEC, UTC, TIMETAG_REF RECEIVE, degrees; data-source/satnogs-optical-source): the station is OBSERVER_ID, its site the $GST of that STATION_ID, else OBSERVER_X/Y/Z (Earth-fixed, m); each pair is one RIGHT_ASCENSION_DECLINATION observation (one-way light time, Sagnac off).

acceptedTypeSets.description: The station coordinates: one $GST per pad from data-source/ilrs-station-coordinates read_sinex (ITRF position and eccentricity, CDP_NUMBER the pad). Every pad of the normal points needs one.

inputPorts.description: The station coordinates: one $GST per pad from data-source/ilrs-station-coordinates read_sinex (ITRF position and eccentricity, CDP_NUMBER the pad). Every pad of the normal points needs one.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The $PRW EARTH_ORIENTATION record propagator/ffm takes ($EOP rows covering the arc): the station rotation uses the same rows.

inputPorts.description: The $PRW EARTH_ORIENTATION record propagator/ffm takes ($EOP rows covering the arc): the station rotation uses the same rows.

acceptedTypeSets.description: A $PRW EXECUTION_REQUEST: INITIAL the first guess (GCRF, UTC), TARGET_EPOCH the estimate's epoch (ISO 8601 UTC), INTEGRATOR and FORCES the dynamics propagator/ffm runs, DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS the solve-for parameters (DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS, SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS, IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION) with their first values in FORCES.

inputPorts.description: A $PRW EXECUTION_REQUEST: INITIAL the first guess (GCRF, UTC), TARGET_EPOCH the estimate's epoch (ISO 8601 UTC), INTEGRATOR and FORCES the dynamics propagator/ffm runs, DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS the solve-for parameters (DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS, SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS, IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION) with their first values in FORCES.

acceptedTypeSets.description: ModuleConfig, optional, numbers: rangeSigmaM (0.05), minimumArcHours (24), maximumIterations (20), editThreshold (5), correctionTolerance (0.01).

inputPorts.description: ModuleConfig, optional, numbers: rangeSigmaM (0.05), minimumArcHours (24), maximumIterations (20), editThreshold (5), correctionTolerance (0.01); angleSigmaArcsec (RA/Dec sigma without an $EOO) and timeBiasSigmaS.<station> (a consider TIME_BIAS for that OBSERVER_ID's angles, the $GST CLOCK_OFFSET_S its value, else 0).

acceptedTypeSets.description: The $EST envelope this node emitted last; absent on the first two calls.

inputPorts.description: The $EST envelope this node emitted last; absent on the first two calls.

acceptedTypeSets.description: propagator/ffm invoke's $PRW EXECUTION_RESULT for this node's last propagation.

inputPorts.description: propagator/ffm invoke's $PRW EXECUTION_RESULT for this node's last propagation.
Optional: one $EOO per RA/Dec observation; the larger of RA_UNC and DECLINATION_UNC (degrees) at the same OB_TIME is that observation's sigma (else config angleSigmaArcsec).
Optional: the source's $PVN, carried onto the $OCM with this node as PRODUCER (required for an angles-only fit; without it a laser fit states ILRS).

acceptedTypeSets.description: A $PRW EXECUTION_REQUEST for propagator/ffm invoke (with its kernel and earth_orientation): the first guess to every receive epoch, or a fit round's seed and parameters to every query epoch with the state transition matrix.

outputPorts.description: A $PRW EXECUTION_REQUEST for propagator/ffm invoke (with its kernel and earth_orientation): the first guess to every receive epoch, or a fit round's seed and parameters to every query epoch with the state transition matrix.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The $EST envelope for analysis/estimation fit_batch: the request (one LASER_RANGE observation per normal point with the station's GCRF state at its receive instant, two-way light time, Marini-Murray troposphere) and every propagation answer so far.

outputPorts.description: The $EST envelope for analysis/estimation fit_batch: the request (one LASER_RANGE observation per normal point with the station's GCRF state at its receive instant, two-way light time, Marini-Murray troposphere) and every propagation answer so far.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The converged fit as one Cartesian $OCM at TARGET_EPOCH: GCRF state (km, km/s), formal covariance, ORBIT_DETERMINATION with the solve-for parameters' fitted values in OD_DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS and FIT_STATISTICS (FIT_RMS_KM the range residual RMS, FIT_STATES and OD_OBSERVATIONS_USED the normal points used, ITERATIONS, CONVERGED, FIT_START, FIT_STOP) and PROVENANCE (SOURCE_KIND Observation, ORIGINATOR ILRS, LICENSE_CLASS Reproducible).

outputPorts.description: The converged fit as one Cartesian $OCM at TARGET_EPOCH: GCRF state (km, km/s), formal covariance, ORBIT_DETERMINATION with the solve-for parameters' fitted values in OD_DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS and FIT_STATISTICS (FIT_RMS_KM the range residual RMS, FIT_STATES and OD_OBSERVATIONS_USED the normal points used, ITERATIONS, CONVERGED, FIT_START, FIT_STOP) and PROVENANCE (SOURCE_KIND Observation, ORIGINATOR ILRS, LICENSE_CLASS Reproducible).
